signals.usability_note: Clear view of a residential frontage across the lawn, though a tree in the foreground partially blocks the right side of the house and the garage area.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Lawn is mowed and mulched tree rings and foundation shrubs are present, but nothing shows crew-level work such as a crew, equipment or sharp edging.

signals.notes: Split-level home with tan siding, a brick chimney and mature trees; the front lawn is green and tidy, and the garage and driveway are partly hidden by the foreground tree.
